params.prompt: Use the reference images for the character Alex and for the old radio; keep the same face, hair, clothes and radio design. Scene: evening in a small, bright rented room in a coastal town. Through the window: a harbour and, far away, a lighthouse at dusk. Alex sits at a wooden desk and carefully places the old green-and-cream radio on the desk. A simple round wall clock with a blank face, no numbers. Calm, curious mood. Vertical composition. Warm animated-series illustration, graphic-novel style, clean ink lines, soft cel shading, coastal palette of sea blue, sand, lighthouse yellow and evening orange, mature tone suitable for teens and adults, not childish, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos.
